FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 193
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Sponsor: Senator Dan Roberts
Economic Development
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 01/26/2026
Senate Bill 193 as introduced would require all personal and non-legal professional services
contracts paid from appropriated funds to be subject to review by the Contract Review
Permanent Legislative Oversight Committee. This bill would not directly affect state or local
funding.
